lyon-rh-ne-alpes-rides-mont-ventoux-long.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: High point near Feurs → Food stop near Saint-Uze rides best with patience. Coastal roads change character with wind and visitors; keep overtakes boring and take the photo from a proper stop.

sections.to: Near Rives, on the way back
sections.advice: Food stop near Saint-Uze → Near Rives, on the way back is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

sections.from: Near Rives, on the way back

sections.advice: Photo stop near Tossiat → Scenic stretch near Chalamont can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Scenic stretch near Chalamont → Near Lentilly is the reward section in Lyon. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
